edits.new: Try to refute coverage in each direction between the fixed information scopes of a local node and a canonical node. Find a concrete case satisfying the proposed child's whole scope and escaping the proposed parent's whole scope. If a direction cannot be refuted, establish complete coverage or leave it unresolved. Derive one relation from both directional results and the canonical consequences.
edits.old: Compare the fixed information scopes of a local node and a canonical node in a hierarchy of broader and narrower topics. Return one relation.
